title: Al-'Asr 103:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-'Asr 103:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 22. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلْعَصْرِ (١) إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ (٢) إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-'Asr 103:1-3 with the teacher.
Listening turns: today's group says 103:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: say it softly 3 times looking, 3 times without.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Tell a friend one good thing you did with your time today.
How many things save us from loss in 103:3?
questions.a: A) 4. Belief, good deeds, advising to truth, advising to patience.

questions.q: Think again: Allah swears by time. What are four things that stop us from losing our time?
questions.a: Believing, doing good deeds, advising each other to the truth and to patience (103:3).
